reviews.comment: Personally, I am a big history nerd who could watch a deemed “boring” presentation for hours on American history, but I do believe Professor Weidemann is so kind. If you communicate with her properly by scheduling a meeting outside of class to understand her grading methods, you'll fly through this class with an A+. Just show up and take your notes

reviews.comment: If you can take this class online do it. She takes attendance on zoom but the lectures help out a lot. Exams usually have around 10 questions, mostly writing but the prompts are given in advance (write them before and save time).
